<untrusted_participant_content>
We’re looking for a creative graphic designer to support branding projects for a growing business. You’ll create polished visual assets, develop cohesive brand materials, and help turn ideas into clear, professional designs. The ideal freelancer is detail-oriented, communicative, and comfortable working on multiple projects at once. If you have experience building strong visual identities and delivering high-quality work on time, we’d love to hear from you.
</untrusted_participant_content>
content.title: Graphic Designer for Branding Projects
